Questions

Good questions, straight answers

How much does mobile billboard advertising cost?

It depends on the route, the number of hours and whether you share the truck or book it exclusively. Shared routes are the most affordable way to start. Tell us your goals and dates and we’ll send a price with your route plan.

What’s the difference between a shared route and an exclusive rental?

On a shared route, your ad rotates on the screen with a few other local businesses on a set schedule. With an exclusive rental, the truck shows only your ad, on the route and hours you choose.

Do you design the ad for me?

Send us your artwork, or tell us your message and we’ll help you format it so it reads clearly on an LED screen from the street.

Where do the trucks drive?

Our scheduled routes cover Dallas (day and nightlife), Frisco, North Dallas and Rockwall County. Exclusive trucks can go anywhere in DFW, plus Austin, Houston and San Antonio.

Can you advertise at the Cowboys game or a concert?

Yes. Event routes are timed around major DFW events so your message is seen by crowds arriving and leaving, on public roads near the venue.

How do I know my ad ran?

You’ll receive a campaign report at the end of your run showing where and when your ad was on the road.
